title.en: Where does Diesel 60 sit on an infrastructure line?
title.zh: 柴油60在基建管路上处在哪一档？

description.en: Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 prints 6105 / 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa and 150 m / 350 m for off-grid rural and infrastructure placement.
description.zh: 柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 印了 6105 / 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、150 m / 350 m，用于无电网的农村与基建浇筑。

h1.en: Where does Diesel 60 sit on an infrastructure line?
h1.zh: 柴油60在基建管路上处在哪一档？

directAnswer.en: Above Diesel 50’s 30 m³/h and below the LZ-80 and Diesel 120 high-output rows. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132 for sites without stable grid power and for rural and infrastructure placement: 6105 diesel 144 kW, 35 m³/h, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 350 m, Kawasaki double pump 100, 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm and 3500 kg.
directAnswer.zh: 在柴油50的 30 m³/h 之上，在 LZ-80 和柴油120的大排量行之下。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油60 / HBT60-13.132 印给电网不稳的工地以及农村与基建浇筑：6105 柴油机 144 kW、35 m³/h、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 350 m、川崎双泵 100、外形 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm、3500 kg。

heading.en: The shared code with LZ-60 is not a shared table
heading.zh: 和 LZ-60 共用的代号不是同一张表

body.en: LZ-60 also prints HBT60-13.132, but its table is 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying 100 m and delivery height 300 m, at 5500 kg, with aggregate 4 cm and below. Diesel 60 does not print that aggregate cell and does not print 50 m³/h. Tell Xingtai which URL you mean.
body.zh: LZ-60 也印了 HBT60-13.132，但它的表是 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送 100 m、输送高度 300 m、5500 kg，骨料 4 cm 及以下。柴油60没有那个骨料格，也没有 50 m³/h。请告诉邢台你指的是哪个地址。

heading.en: Continuous infrastructure feed still uses catalogue output
heading.zh: 基建连续供料仍然用目录输送量

body.en: The published bridge note treats continuous feed as a reason to compare catalogue output, and it includes Diesel 60 beside Diesel 50 and LZ-80. 35 m³/h remains a theoretical cell. It is not a measured deck rate and not a pier schedule.
body.zh: 已发布的桥梁说明把连续供料当成对照目录输送量的理由，并把柴油60和柴油50、LZ-80 放在一起。35 m³/h 仍然是理论格。它不是测到的桥面速率，也不是墩柱工期。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Quote /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump if that is the 35 m³/h table you want. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 如果你要的是 35 m³/h 这张表，请引用 /products/diesel-60-concrete-pump。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. The cell is 150 m / 350 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 不是。格子是水平/垂直 150 m / 350 m。

answer.en: Not in the specification list extracted for this model. Do not borrow 4 cm from LZ-60 or 6 cm from LZ-80.
answer.zh: 这台的规格表里没有。不要向 LZ-60 借 4 cm，也不要向 LZ-80 借 6 cm。

question.en: Is 144 kW the same as LZ-60’s 145 kW?
question.zh: 144 kW 和 LZ-60 的 145 kW 一样吗？

answer.en: They are printed as different cells on different pages, with different output and distance.
answer.zh: 它们印在不同页面上，是不同的格子，输送量和距离也不同。
